CustomObject.label: Pricing Rule
CustomObject.description: Revenue Core - typed pricing rules. Replaces Revenue Cloud Advanced BundleBasedAdjustment, ProductSellingModelOption and the RCA decision tables. Rules are typed by Rule_Type__c and are never a catch-all product rule (UC-DM-11 explicit rejection). Evaluated by PricingService (docs/revenue-core/03-REVENUE-CORE-SPEC.md 3.2).
